title: The Shrine of Trials
text: A shrine to the Six with a basin of coals before it, glowing red, never fed. The devout may walk the coals and be blessed, the sign says. Anyone else is burned. The stones around the basin are scattered with cinders that look like toes.

options.label: The most devout walks the coals, and trusts the Six to know them.

outcomes.text: Not a blister. The Six are pleased.
The Six are not so sure.

options.label: Pray before the shrine, and leave the coals to the faithful.

outcomes.text: The coals glow kindly, and warm you through.

options.label: Douse the coals and take the basin. No god needs brass.

outcomes.text: Brass, heavy, and very old, and the coals hiss as they die.
